source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 709 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 709 was established by Ordinance No. 25826, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 8, 2004. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 709 is established on property located at the northwest corner of Hillcrest Road and Willow Lane. The size of PD 709 is approximately 15.76 acres. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a church, development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 709A). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development/landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted in this district are those permitted in the R-16(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-16(A) Single Family District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the R-16(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-16(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.106. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional

regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as otherwise provided in this section, yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-16(A) Single Family District apply in this district.

(b) Height. For a church, maximum structure height is 41 feet.

(c) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage for a church is 15 percent. Above ground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(d) Stories. For a church, maximum number of stories is two.

(e) Floor area. For a church, maximum floor area is 166,367 square feet as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A- 4.200 for the specific off-street parking/loading requirements for each use.

(b) For a church with up to 1,836 seats, a minimum of 927 parking spaces must be maintained on the site. Any additional seats added to the site must comply with the off-street parking regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200. Seats means fixed seats in the sanctuary or auditorium. If fixed benches or pews are provided, each 18 inches of length of the fixed bench or pew constitutes one fixed seat for the purpose of this paragraph. If portions of the seating areas in the sanctuary or auditorium are not equipped with fixed seats, benches, or pews, the parking requirement for those portions is one space for each 28 square feet of floor area. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.110. SIGNS.

(a) Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII.

(b) Protective signs must be provided at all vehicular entrances and exits to the Property. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) For a church, landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(c) For a church, landscaping along the Willow Lane frontage must be provided as shown on the landscape detail (Exhibit 709B). Phase I must be completed within six months of December 8, 2004, and Phase II must be completed within 18 months of December 8, 2004.

(d) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.112. LIGHTING.

(a) For a church, parking lot lighting must comply with Section 51A-4.301(e)(2), except that parking lot light standards must not exceed 12 feet in height.

(b) For a church, additional exterior lighting is permitted in and below trees for security purposes, subject to the limitations set forth for parking lot light standards, except that lights must not be located more than 12 feet above grade. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Ingress And Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.113. INGRESS AND EGRESS.

(a) For a church, ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the attached development/landscape plan.

(b) For a church, access to Talmadge Lane and Archdale Drive is prohibited.

(c) For a church, access to Willow Lane is limited to one location as shown on the development/landscape plan. A gate must be placed across the Willow Lane driveway, and this drive must be restricted to emergency access only. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.114. SCREENING.

(a) For a church, walls and fences must be constructed and located as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(b) For a church, a minimum three-foot-high earthen berm must be constructed as shown on the development/landscape plan; the berm and solid screening wall must provide an eight-foot-high solid screen, except for the wrought iron gate shown on the development/landscape plan.

(c) For all other permitted uses, walls and fences must be provided in accordance with the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use in this district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 25826)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-709.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 709 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. 25826)
